scope: All 55 approved P1.4 grouped terminology/help proposals, plus new Orb guide. Raw internal protocol/state/diagnostic identifiers intentionally preserved. No native visual proof.

items.prior_label: Builds / My Builds / Saved Build / Loadout / Snapshot / Wishlist / destination
items.implementation: Build Library, server My Builds/Saved Build, selected loadout, desired Wishlist and Snapshot defined separately.

items.prior_label: Assign / associated / destination wishlist / Clear association
items.implementation: Assignment/unassignment explained separately from creating, saving or activating; underlying ownership unchanged.

items.prior_label: First Run
items.implementation: Zero-slot first run, unavailable and empty-numbered-slot labels distinguished without changing branch selection.

items.prior_label: Swap / Loadout: choose build
items.implementation: My Builds/Open My Builds labels describe navigation rather than promising activation.

items.prior_label: Use Current Build / Browse Proven Builds
items.implementation: Set up current build, Import/Create Wishlist, Browse Community builds; no proven-build claim.

items.prior_label: LOCKED ECHOES ... Nexus can only read these, never lock/unlock them
items.implementation: Current permanent Echoes are counted/displayed; false never-lock/unlock claim removed. Optional automation documented separately.

items.prior_label: Locked / designed locks / locked-slot targets / frozen / Lock / Unlock
items.implementation: Current permanent Echoes, permanent-slot targets, frozen offers, read-only Echo list and position-lock vocabulary distinguished.

items.prior_label: Automate locked Echo slots / Checked: ... automatically once each is acquired
items.implementation: Automatic permanent-slot text requires both master Automation and the separate option plus validated ownership/capability.

items.prior_label: Nexus will unlock this one and lock the new one in automatically once it’s acquired
items.implementation: Replacement tooltip/notice avoids promising automatic lock changes merely after target selection.

items.prior_label: 79 total Echoes / 79/79 wishlist / 6 designed locks / entries / variants / names
items.implementation: 79 rolled copies plus six permanent-slot targets; save count clearly separate from designed targets.

items.prior_label: Confirm roles & edit / Confirm roles & assign / complete split / locked copies
items.implementation: Permanent-target confirmation terminology; source/role preservation unaffected.

items.prior_label: Suggest my matching locks / Untagged Wishlist roles / currentlocks
items.implementation: Current-lock default explained as matching intended targets; existing confirmed plans are not rewritten.

items.prior_label: Wishlist identity found / authoritative lock evidence / server mirror / roles remain unknown
items.implementation: Resolvable permanent-target choice separated from waiting for actual server lock data; raw detail retained, no advice to delete original Wishlist.

items.prior_label: Save complete — immediate readback was non-canonical
items.implementation: Unconfirmed-save branch now says request sent, confirmation missing; confirmed branch still requires confirmation.

items.prior_label: Paste an EBH1 wishlist string / wishlist + locked Echoes, as an EBH1 string
items.implementation: Wishlist import code instead of unexplained EBH1; Nexus-only role-marker distinction documented.

items.prior_label: Load Import / imported as new wishlist ... Review and Create Wishlist
items.implementation: Open imported draft; import/save/assignment separate actions.

items.prior_label: invalid wishlist / invalid loadout / payload changed / preview is stale
items.implementation: Invalid build/plan/stale draft gives a known reason/action and preserves raw detail without forcing acceptance.

items.prior_label: Auto: ON / Auto Mode; tooltip lists picks, Banish and Reroll
items.implementation: Automation master permission and per-action spending/slot effects explained.

items.prior_label: Take wanted Echo (Pilot) / Freeze ... before search / search unavailable
items.implementation: Player action labels omit Pilot suffix; policy provenance remains in About and documentation.

items.prior_label: +106 / -15 beside a card
items.implementation: Normal recommendation lines use need/category descriptions rather than unexplained signed priority numbers; diagnostics remain intact.

items.prior_label: Filler picks are correct behavior / It will be replaced in a future run
items.implementation: Off-Wishlist picks explained without claiming every choice is correct or guaranteed to be replaced.

items.prior_label: TO SHED / Echoes to shed / incomplete tooltip / will shed next run
items.implementation: EXTRA COPIES and complete explanatory tooltip; no delete or future replacement promise.

items.prior_label: TO LOCK / locked-slot targets to acquire
items.implementation: Permanent targets remaining in place of TO LOCK.

items.prior_label: unsynced / waiting for owned-echo sync
items.implementation: Waiting for current Echo data is distinct from shared-build network Sync.

items.prior_label: armed / unarmed / arms the guarantee / seeds one
items.implementation: Saved-build guarantee confirmation language replaces armed/unarmed on normal display; raw states remain support evidence.

items.prior_label: banked / returns later / tight horizon / bracket fishing / drain guaranteed queue
items.implementation: Expected later/held offer/remaining-choice language; predictions distinguished from confirmed live-card guarantees.
Charge names and overlay symbol legend supplied; diagnostic abbreviations retained as stable support format.

items.prior_label: tome lever / anchor / diversity / flag demotions
items.implementation: Advanced assumption and Echo-availability control terms explained; raw IDs preserved when a reliable display name is unavailable.

items.prior_label: This is NOT an addon error. The addon is correct. / Missing Tomes
items.implementation: Server-reported availability explanation replaces categorical claims that Nexus cannot be wrong.

items.prior_label: Orb state active or unknown / waiting for three-card board / pending-pick count
items.implementation: Ordinary rolling waits during Orb-owned/unknown states; real Orb mode uses a distinct permitted path.

items.prior_label: Qualified Only / Unqualified / proven builds
items.implementation: Both DPS records / missing required records; no qualification-as-quality implication.

items.prior_label: Strongest Pair / Avg
items.implementation: Both records plus explicit highest-single-result ranking and display-only average explanation.

items.prior_label: Global best / ranked records / Connected to the Nexus sync mesh
items.implementation: Known/shared record language without claiming a live connection or universal best result.

items.prior_label: Publish / Share / Post / Uploading
items.implementation: Share Build vocabulary and local save/server-save distinction.

items.prior_label: Delete / Remove / Stop Sharing
items.implementation: Stop Sharing/removing a shared record differs from server My Builds deletion; exact action semantics retained.

items.prior_label: Echo list locked by leaderboard record / Leaderboard loadout locked
items.implementation: Read-only Echo list tied to DPS records, not a permanent-lock metaphor.

items.prior_label: Show Performance / PERFORMANCE / Perf
items.implementation: DPS records versus runtime Performance diagnostics.

items.prior_label: Copy into Editor / Open Build / Request Loadout / Echo rows
items.implementation: Request full Echo list; copying opens a draft and does not activate/spend.

items.prior_label: record fingerprint / Echo evidence / Class unavailable / Legacy
items.implementation: Missing/older/class/record mismatch display language; raw fingerprints and support fields are not rewritten.

items.prior_label: Sync Now / syncing / preparing / sending / cleaning / throttled
items.implementation: Preparing, sent, receiving, cleaning-expired and completion remain distinct; underlying transport unchanged.

items.prior_label: Preparing build identities / Committing prepared Community data / validation steps / no readiness checks were bypassed
items.implementation: Plain-language loading phases replace build identities/commit jargon; no fake readiness or scheduler changes.

items.prior_label: Current phase: n/N (%) / Nexus ready / local tools ready
items.implementation: This-step percentage and local versus shared availability explicit; no overall ETA promise.

items.prior_label: Fixes: flags | undemote | anchor <id|off> | restore | err
items.implementation: Advanced troubleshooting commands explained as specific effects, not generic fixes.

items.prior_label: Copy Full Diagnostic Log / Select All / one compact diagnostic block
items.implementation: Prepare full diagnostic report / Select this page; complete copy requires pages in order.

items.prior_label: Boards / Mismatch / State / AutoLock / Perf / Peer Test / provider error
items.implementation: Recent choices, manual overrides, status, permanent-slot actions, performance and advanced peer diagnostics.

items.prior_label: guarantees of responsiveness in export text: so gameplay stays responsive / you may keep playing
items.implementation: No guarantee that export will avoid hitches; large reports may take a moment.

items.prior_label: Optimizer / readout notes “loadout activation ... level-1-only”
items.implementation: Recommendation wording and server-supported activation limits; no claim every Wishlist is a Snapshot.

items.prior_label: ROOT_*, STORE_*, evidence/source drift, mirror, schema, receipt, generation, fingerprint, payload
items.implementation: Known-condition explanations with retained Details/raw codes, not arbitrary suppression or validation bypass.

items.prior_label: shed [Echo] / loadout cleaned up / wishlist rotation / exact progress / no net gain / pollution / baseline / ratchet
items.implementation: Save comparisons use gained/fewer matching copies; separate from the EXTRA COPIES panel. Raw Ratchet reason strings retained.

items.prior_label: Experimental integrated Nexus prototype — LoadoutPilot-derived ordinary rolling, Wishlists, Community, DPS, Snapshot and Sync.
items.implementation: Concrete player-task description including optional Orb refinement; experimental limitations and provenance separate.

items.prior_label: One-time Welcome to Nexus; Later records hasSeenQuickStart
items.implementation: Persistent Help/Getting Started controls and seven pages, no mandatory wizard.

items.prior_label: /nexus help and /nexus print a short command list without descriptions
items.implementation: /nexus help/guide/tutorial reopen real guide, not just a terse command list.

items.prior_label: Help omits reroll, freeze, currentlocks, prototype; only loading dispatches before initialization
items.implementation: Early help/orbs/loader routing; reroll/freeze/currentlocks/prototype and Orb control meanings documented.

items.prior_label: README current test.9005 instructions followed by historical test.9004 instructions and absent docs/tools paths
items.implementation: Current P1.5 install/user guide replaces mixed old instructions; full older README preserved only in source history.

items.prior_label: Nexus 1.20 Beta changelog / Faster large libraries / migrates additively
items.implementation: Current P1.5-specific changelog and seen key; no unsupported faster/migration guarantee.
